metas.name: ★ 9.1 · 2017 · The Chosen

metas.name: ★ 8.8 · 2019 · When They See Us
metas.description: Five teens from Harlem become trapped in a nightmare when they're falsely accused of a brutal attack in Central Park. Based on the true story.

metas.name: ★ 8.7 · 2015 · Narcos
metas.description: A chronicled look at the criminal exploits of Colombian drug lord Pablo Escobar, as well as the many other drug kingpins who plagued the country through the years.

metas.name: ★ 8.6 · 2016 · The Crown
metas.description: Follows the political rivalries and romances of Queen Elizabeth II's reign and the events that shaped Britain for the second half of the 20th century.

metas.name: ★ 8.6 · 2015 · The Jinx: The Life and Deaths of Robert Durst
metas.description: Filmmaker Andrew Jarecki examines the complicated life of reclusive real estate icon Robert Durst, the key suspect in a series of unsolved crimes.

metas.name: ★ 8.4 · 2016 · American Crime Story
metas.description: An anthology series centered around America's most notorious crimes and criminals. American Crime Story focuses on epic events in America's history.

metas.name: ★ 8.3 · 2018 · Narcos: Mexico
metas.description: The rise of the Guadalajara Cartel as an American DEA agent learns the danger of targeting narcos in Mexico.

metas.name: ★ 8.2 · 2016 · Victoria
metas.description: The early life of Queen Victoria, from her ascension to the throne at the tender age of 18 to her courtship and marriage to Prince Albert.

metas.name: ★ 8.2 · 2017 · Feud
metas.description: An anthology series centering on famous feuds, including Bette Davis and Joan Crawford, and Truman Capote and the New York elite.

metas.name: ★ 8.1 · 2017 · Manhunt

metas.name: ★ 7.9 · 2019 · The Spy
metas.description: Based on the life of Israeli spy Eli Cohen.

metas.name: ★ 7.9 · 2018 · Escape at Dannemora

metas.name: ★ 7.7 · 2019 · Conversations with a Killer: The Ted Bundy Tapes
metas.description: A look inside the mind of serial killer Ted Bundy, featuring interviews with him on death row.
